interpretation: A frozen semantic forward test of reader-facing academic artifacts. It does not estimate acceptance, scientific truth, or AI authorship.

scale.1: Recognizes part of the task but contains a material reasoning, evidence, or genre failure
scale.2: Mostly safe and partly correct, but not publication-ready; important relation or evidence is missing, or the response remains an audit/checklist instead of the requested artifact
scale.3: Scientifically sound and usable with one editorial pass; a minor omission, weak transition, or underdeveloped publication consequence remains
scale.4: Publication-facing, exact, coherent, evidence-complete for its claim, humanly voiced, and immediately usable without a substantive editorial repair

dimensions.label: Publication thesis, intellectual pressure, and contribution value
Method, unit, denominator, and analysis alignment
Null, mixed, failure, resistance, and harm integration
Human, material, institutional, and model agency or labor visibility
Author voice, stance, and genre-appropriate register
Precision, paragraph reasoning, readability, and accessibility
Citation, quotation, copyright, and provenance integrity
Requested-artifact fit, venue care, and author actionability
